items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know Jimmy Owens? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No kidding. ... [INTERVIEWER] ... I gave it to Jimmy Owens for his birthday ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well let's see, I was on trumpet. Johnny Coles and (Marvin?) Peterson.

ctx.x: died Kenny Durham/two weeks ago. I would have called Kenny. I called him before, he worked with me at ~~slug's~~ Slug's . . . ?).
